Name: Farmhouse Exponential Farming
Author: Meshu94
Description:
Feeling like you don't have enough land outside your house?
Would you like to have some animal stuff going on by your side without scarifying your precious farmland?
On top of that, would you like to have it working on the newest release of your favorite game?
No problem! This mods add more space for crops at your house, which gets bigger as you progress with your house/cabin expansions.

[u][u]Quick note, it's not a client side mod. If the host doesn't have the mod installed, there is a high chance that crops planted indoor will disappear on the next morning![/u][/u]

[u]No upgrades:[/u]
[list]
[*]10x10 farming area
[*]1 water source
[/list][u]First upgrade:[/u]
[list]
[*]Keep previous area (10x10 + 1 water source)
[*]Additional 22x15 farming area + 2 water sources
[/list][u]Second upgrade:
[/u]
[list]
[*]Keep initial area (10x10 + 1 water source)
[*]Second area expanded to 40x25 +8 water sources
[*]2 extra areas 26x3 on the sides for your extra needs!
[/list]
[size=2]Requirement:[/size]
[size=2]Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=2]Content Patcher[/size]

[/url][size=2]Installation:
[/size][size=2]1. Download[/size] [size=2]Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=2]Content Patcher
[/size][/url][size=2]2. Extract this mod to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
3. Run the game with smapi[/size]
[size=2]4. Enjoy[/size]
